claim_summary: Pilot design is 40 graphs, four families, two sizes, ten seeds, p=1, budgets 25/50/100
400 runs and 16,370 calls completed in 53.49 seconds
T26 passed with no duplicate IDs, join failures, accounting failures, or exclusions
The staged dataset is traceable and MIT licensed
Mean normalized gap changed from 0.22726 at budget 25 to 0.22554 at 100
Seed sensitivity differs by graph family
No p=1 run reached the 95% target and evaluations-to-target is not estimable
Expanded features did not beat the baseline in leave-one-family-out evaluation
The mandatory study is limited to small noiseless p=1 simulation and one optimizer
The exploratory p=2 subset cannot establish p=2 superiority
Optimizer choice and sampling noise will materially change seed sensitivity
Deeper QAOA improves gap only with a larger search budget
Topology features become useful after graph-family and size coverage increases
Dataset v0.2 will enable controlled optimizer and backend comparisons
